description:
Migrate the semantic layer off follow_up: work runs only via waits (pull) or changed-revision wakes.

Owner's law (2026-07-02): follow_up is an anti-northstar SMELL. Work runs for exactly two reasons: a consumer WAITS on a named fact/product (pull), or a CHANGED REVISION wakes a recorded reader. Owner's sharpening: 'if a push-based / pass-based idea is being smuggled back in under a different name, that's a violation of the spirit of the pull/demand based approach. period.'

FAMILIES 1-7 — DONE (e561842ce, 1ab96d652, d8fa56ed1, d9b5f0112, d332eadab, ef6ea7b5a, f7a5ca3d9): seed pushes deleted; scheduler demand-on-stall keystone; body/dispatch/contract/types push-free; semantic.rs fully converted; standing activation frontier replaced the last callee-discovery push (has_run pre-filter is LOAD-BEARING for unbounded standing-demand sets).

PUMP RESIDUAL — DONE (2e431abfc, three-lane audited PASS/PASS/PASS 2026-07-03): resolve_protocol_call now subscribes to ProtocolImplProviders(protocol) UNCONDITIONALLY (the has_fact-conditional reads.push dropped the first-pass re-wake subscription). Verdict: the fact is MONOTONE-GROWING — structurally guaranteed, ProtocolImplProviderMap::register only pushes and NO source-redefinition/retraction API exists in World — so an unconditional read subscription is correct and a blocking wait would be wrong. DependencyIndex::replace_reads subscribes regardless of fact existence (audit-verified mechanism). THE TEMPORARY PUMP IS DELETED: demand_producer_if_needed now has five explicit branches — never-run: demand; rebased: demand (family-7 bypass, order-proven irrelevant since never-run jobs cannot be rebased); claims: skip; blocked: skip; concluded-without-claiming: SKIP OUTRIGHT (was the pump's re-demand). Truth-tabled: only the intended cell changed. Red-first re-wake test in world_test.rs (defimpl in a later source unit re-wakes the callsite; red 10/10-stable-green verified). Telemetry: pokes flat-or-lower everywhere (enum_take_drop_split stabilized), 0 stalls on healthy fixtures both sides, stall-exit path proven non-spinning. Audit-noted for posterity: contract.rs:25 and types.rs:26 bare Ok(default()) conclusions are safe because their facts are immutable-by-construction (no redefinition API); runtime_demand.rs:2901/2907 has_fact checks are the pull.rs product subsystem (defensive, caller gates on settled waits), not the drive graph.

REMAINING — FAMILY 8 (counts re-verified at 26b41161a): jobs/keying.rs 8 (collect_static_graph); jobs/root.rs 5 (root wait threading); quoted_expander.rs 4 + source_publish.rs 2 (same ModuleInterface wait_on_current pattern); jobs/source.rs 3; world.rs 1 = consumption site (effects.follow_up into scheduler.complete — dies at arc close with the JobEffects field). drive.rs 3 + scheduler.rs 6 = framework plumbing, die at arc close.

ARC CLOSE (after family 8): delete JobEffects::follow_up field + world.rs consumption + scheduler plumbing; delete the .18.19 coalesce screen (scheduler.rs:241-247 conclusion_stands follow_up coalescing — still load-bearing until family 8 lands); aggregate follow-up-emission counter for the follow_ups=0 proof; split coalesced-telemetry observability; Scheduler::blocked/has_run pub-visibility sweep; fact-engine.md legacy clause; northstar.html tolerance clause. WATCH: product wait loops now live in compiler2::product_drive (fz-go4.19) — the stall_demanded-style suppression memo remains unadded there (traced: no repeated-redemand loop exists inside one fact-wait call; separate concern). Root-entry double-coverage (roots in both demand_root_entry_analyses and the frontier) remains harmless/idempotent. Sequencing: fz-go4.18.31 AFTER family 8.

comments.text: STARTING INVENTORY from the .18.19 removable-code audit (2026-07-02, at 424b2ae6a): (1) FIRST REMOVAL, proof complete: seed_root's LowerFunction + PlanEntryDispatch follow_ups (root.rs:75-76) are provably ALWAYS-COALESCED — the concluding branch requires Recursive+DispatchMask facts, whose producers (keying.rs:148-152 -> body.rs:287; keying.rs:84-90 -> dispatch.rs:169) must therefore have concluded; first-run demand already lives in DeriveRecursive/DeriveDispatchMask; change waves handle re-runs. Safe to delete as this arc's first family (own commit). (2) KEEP-classified: root.rs:77/:112 AnalyzeActivation (genuine first-run demand for a just-minted activation); ALL other emissions are absence-gated wait+demand pairs (semantic.rs:219/1257/1301/1492/1647/2265, dispatch, body, keying, source, world.rs:2094/2102, quoted_expander, source_publish) — these are the wait-implies-demand conversion targets. (3) Product-side jobs (artifact/runtime_demand/transport/backend/native) emit ZERO follow_ups already. (4) Minor: the coalesced telemetry channel conflates agenda-dedupe (scheduler.rs:257) with standing-conclusion suppression (scheduler.rs:228-232) — split the observability when this arc lands. (5) Watch item from the cross-lane note: semantic.rs:1255-1258 demands DefineModule(protocol) while waiting on ProtocolDispatch — the one site where a follow_up forced a concluded job's re-run as a wait-unblocking mechanism; resolve its real producer relationship during migration.
